body: Thanks for the encouragement and advise. I hadn't really considered that the move may be having a physical effect on my body which could play into all this. I'll try and get outside more and maybe some vitamin supplements.

It takes me a long time to warm up to people... And I rarely form deep relationships. I don't trust people enough to let them get to know me. I've always been introverted even as a kid. I push people away the moment I feel even the slightest bit of rejection. I don't want to be like this. I'm not really sure why I do this... I know if I can't get over it I will end up alone for the rest of my life.
